description: This file defines classes related to handling the connection preamble in Orleans networking, including serialization/deserialization of connection metadata such as protocol version, node identity, and address information.

classes.name: ConnectionPreamble
classes.description: Represents the metadata sent at the start of a connection, including protocol version, node identity, silo address, and cluster ID.

classes.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
classes.description: Provides methods to serialize and deserialize ConnectionPreamble objects over network connections, including writing length-prefixed data streams.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a ConnectionPreamble object and writes it to the network connection, prefixing it with its length.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a ConnectionPreamble object from the network connection, handling length-prefixed data and connection termination cases.

methods.name: WriteLength
methods.description: Writes the length of the preamble as a 4-byte little-endian integer into the output buffer.
